clip_texts: SC-09 Lane keeping where localisation is degraded

Driving in lane beside oncoming traffic or the sidewalk on a street with few features, many moved objects, or large
vehicles blocking the view

One concrete scenario (seeded sample of the logical
scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 7.5 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-01 Area: geofence
ODD-02 Road type: centre-line
ODD-03 Posted speed limit: 30 mph (the stated bound)
ODD-07 Lane markings: markings-visible
ODD-08 Temporary changes: none
ODD-15 Connectivity: gnss-lost
ODD-17 Traffic density: free-flow
ODD-06 Road surface and geometry: 5.3 % (range 0 to 8 %)

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
Safety goals at stake

SG-02 (ASIL D): Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a
collision the planned trajectory avoids

SG-04 (ASIL D): Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned
path

SG-06 (ASIL D): Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or
crosswalk against right of way
Pass criterion

The vehicle stays in its lane and drivable area; a steering
command toward a detected road user or kerb is rejected and the
vehicle stops in lane; a degraded pose is detected (FSR-04.01,
FSR-04.02, FSR-04.03, FSR-04.05, FSR-02.02, FSR-03.01, FSR-06.01,
FM-09, AC-02)
Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
Meant to do: keeps its lane, or stops in it
Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle
Where the hazard lies: HE-04.1 Steers into the oncoming lane; HE-04.3 Steers onto the sidewalk at low speed
QUALITATIVE ILLUSTRATION · NOT A SIMULATION RESULT · DRAFT FOR ENGINEERING REVIEW
